name: MOAB - MOther of All fan Brackets

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a parametric PCB-mounting fan bracket, designed to snap onto the edges of a printed circuit board. It consists of a flat horizontal support beam connecting two perpendicular vertical legs. The ends of these legs feature specialized mounting clips with narrow vertical slots and cylindrical outer profiles to securely grip the edges of a PCB.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric OpenSCAD script for a PCB fan bracket. The script should allow the user to adjust parameters such as the PCB width, bracket height, bracket length, and thickness, creating a solid clip-on structure that bridges across the board.
captions.factory: The bracket is constructed using a boolean difference operation. The main body is created by unioning a flat horizontal base cube, an optional cross-brace cube, and two vertical leg structures. Each leg is formed from a union of vertical cubes and hexagonal cylinders, which then have small cylinders and rectangular slots subtracted from them to form the precise PCB edge-gripping clips.
